text_block_list.text: This spell should be imbued with a mysterious force at dusk that really powers it up…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Three Goddesses! I challenge you to a magic duel!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'll use a reflect spell so your magic doesn't work on me… Let's see if you can break my spell!
